name: Garmus Grizzler
original_name: ガルムス・グリズラー
source: Marshal governing the territory of North Capital Kisara. Garmus is an old veteran who has long ruled the region and is called the toughest warrior of the empire, and has come to be known as the "Battle Demon" with respect and awe. Garmus watch the trends of other field marshals, standing neutral himself.
